Object.summary: Base class of all Chili UI objects and the root of every control and container; provides parent-child hierarchy, visibility and layer ordering, listener dispatch and coordinate conversion.

props.classname: Class identifier string, used by InheritsFrom and for default instance names; defaults to 'object'.
props.defaultWidth: Default width in pixels, used when width is not set explicitly; defaults to 10.
props.defaultHeight: Default height in pixels, used when height is not set explicitly; defaults to 10.
props.visible: Whether the object is visible; defaults to true. hidden is its negated synonym field.
props.preserveChildrenOrder: When true, removing a child keeps the remaining order; when false, adding/removing children is faster but the children array order becomes unreliable; defaults to false.
props.children: Array of child controls ordered by layer; child objects and their hardlinks are also used as keys to store layer indices.
props.children_hidden: Children detached by HideChild that still belong to this control; each value stores the saved layer index plus links to the preceding/following neighbour.
props.childrenByName: Weak table mapping child name -> child hardlink, used by GetChildByName for fast lookup.
props.OnDispose: Listener list invoked by Dispose when the object is released.
props.OnClick: Listener list for mouse click events; a truthy return value from a handler stops propagation.
props.OnDblClick: Listener list for mouse double-click events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnMouseDown: Listener list for mouse down events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnMouseUp: Listener list for mouse up events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnMouseMove: Listener list for mouse move events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnMouseWheel: Listener list for mouse wheel events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnMouseOver: Listener list for mouse enter events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnMouseOut: Listener list for mouse leave events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnKeyPress: Listener list for key press events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnTextInput: Listener list for text input events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnFocusUpdate: Listener list for focus update events; a truthy return value stops propagation.
props.OnHide: Listener list invoked when the object goes from visible to hidden (triggered by Hide).
props.OnShow: Listener list invoked when the object goes from hidden to visible (triggered by Show).
props.OnOrphan: Listener list invoked when the object loses its parent (SetParent called with nil).
props.OnParent: Listener list invoked when a new parent is assigned, before the parent pointer is written.
props.OnParentPost: Listener list invoked after the parent has been set.
props.disableChildrenHitTest: When true, hit testing of children is skipped so children no longer respond to mouse events; defaults to false.

Object:New.desc: Create a class instance: fixes parameter-name casing, auto-generates name, merges class default tables, sets the metatable and hardlink, and adopts parent/children.

params.obj: initial field table for the instance (optional)

Object:Dispose.desc: Release the object's unmanaged resources, dispose children recursively and invoke OnDispose listeners; safe to call repeatedly.

params._internal: internal flag; when true, checks whether the object is still referenced and warns on the console

Object:AutoDispose.desc: Entry point called by the garbage collector; equivalent to Dispose(true). (internal)

Object:Clone.desc: Clone the object; currently an unimplemented stub that returns an empty table.

Object:Inherit.desc: Derive a subclass: sets the inherited pointer, copies fields the parent has that the class lacks (tables are shallow-copied) and rebuilds __lowerkeys.

Object:SetParent.desc: Set the parent object, invoking OnParent/OnParentPost listeners, forcing visible to true and calling Invalidate; a non-table argument clears the parent pointer and fires OnOrphan.

params.obj: new parent object, may be nil

Object:AddChild.desc: Add obj as a child control (registers its name, detaches it from any previous parent and calls SetParent), inserts it at the given layer index and calls Invalidate.

params.dontUpdate: reserved parameter, unused by the current implementation
params.index: layer index to insert at; appended to the end when omitted

Object:RemoveChild.desc: Remove child from the child list and clear its name registration; deletes in order when preserveChildrenOrder is set, otherwise fills the gap with the last element. Removing from the hidden list just returns true.
Object:RemoveChild.returns: true on success, false if not a child

Object:ClearChildren.desc: Remove all children (first calling ShowChild to restore hidden ones), temporarily disabling preserveChildrenOrder for speed.

Object:IsEmpty.desc: Return whether the control has no visible children.
Object:IsEmpty.returns: true when there are no visible children

Object:HideChild.desc: Move a child from the visible list into children_hidden, recording its layer index and neighbours so it can be restored in place; non-children or repeated hides print a warning.

Object:ShowChild.desc: Re-attach a child from children_hidden at its recorded neighbour position or layer index.

Object:SetVisibility.desc: Set visibility: attaches or detaches self through the parent's ShowChild/HideChild and keeps the visible and hidden fields in sync.

Object:Hide.desc: Hide the object; invokes OnHide listeners if it was not already hidden.

Object:Show.desc: Show the object; invokes OnShow listeners if it was not already visible.

Object:SetChildLayer.desc: Move a child to the given layer index (negative counts from the end, out-of-range values are clamped) and call Invalidate to redraw.

params.layer: target layer index; negative means counting from the end

Object:SetLayer.desc: Ask the parent to move self to the given layer index; does nothing when there is no parent.

Object:SendToBack.desc: Move self to the bottom of the parent's child stack (SetLayer(-1)).

Object:BringToFront.desc: Move self to the top of the parent's child stack (SetLayer(1)).

Object:InheritsFrom.desc: Return whether this object is of class classname or a subclass of it, walking the inherited chain recursively.
Object:InheritsFrom.returns: true when the object inherits from that class

Object:GetChildByName.desc: Look up a direct child (including hidden ones) by name.

Object:GetObjectByName.desc: Recursively find a descendant at any depth (including hidden children) by name, consulting the childrenByName cache first.

Object:FindParent.desc: Walk up the parent chain and return the first parent matching the predicate: a class name is checked with InheritsFrom, a function with its return value.
Object:FindParent.returns: the matching parent object, or nil

Object:IsDescendantOf.desc: Return whether self is a descendant of object by comparing ancestors level by level.
Object:IsDescendantOf.returns: true when self is a descendant

Object:IsAncestorOf.desc: Recursively determine whether object is a descendant of self and report the relative depth.
Object:IsAncestorOf.returns: boolean; when true, the second return value is the relative depth

Object:CallListeners.desc: Call each listener in order with self and the event arguments; stops and returns true as soon as one returns a truthy value.

event arguments passed to the listeners

Object:CallListeners.returns: true when a listener returned truthy

Object:CallListenersInverse.desc: Call the listeners in reverse order; stops as soon as one returns a truthy value.

event arguments passed to the listeners

Object:CallListenersInverse.returns: true when a listener returned truthy

Object:CallChildren.desc: Call the method named eventname on each child in order; stops and returns the result as soon as one returns non-nil.

Object:CallChildrenInverse.desc: Call eventname on the children in reverse order (last child first); stops as soon as one returns non-nil.

Object:CallChildrenInverseCheckFunc.desc: Call eventname in reverse order on children accepted by checkfunc; stops as soon as one returns non-nil.

Object:CallChildrenHT.desc: Walk children in reverse order doing hit tests, calling eventname on hit children with coordinates in their local space; returns nil when disableChildrenHitTest is true.

Object:CallChildrenHTWeak.desc: Like CallChildrenHT, but only checks the child's bounding rectangle without calling HitTest; used for weak hits such as the mouse wheel.

Object:RequestUpdate.desc: Register self with the TaskHandler so its Update method runs on the next frame.

Object:Invalidate.desc: Hook for requesting a redraw; empty in the base class and overridden by subclasses such as Control.

Object:Draw.desc: Let every child draw itself in reverse order (calls their Draw).

Object:TweakDraw.desc: Call TweakDraw on every child in reverse order for post-draw processing.

Object:LocalToParent.desc: Convert local coordinates to parent coordinates by adding the object's own x/y.

Object:ParentToLocal.desc: Convert parent coordinates to local coordinates by subtracting the object's own x/y.

Object:LocalToClient.desc: Convert local coordinates to client coordinates; the base class returns them unchanged (overridden by subclasses).

Object:CorrectlyImplementedLocalToScreen.desc: Correctly implemented local-to-screen conversion (delegates straight to the parent's ClientToScreen); the legacy LocalToScreen semantics are wrong but widely relied upon, hence this extra function.

Object:LocalToScreen.desc: Convert local coordinates to screen coordinates: LocalToParent then the parent's ClientToScreen; for historical reasons the offset may be applied more than once.

Object:UnscaledLocalToScreen.desc: Convert local coordinates to unscaled screen coordinates (LocalToParent then the parent's UnscaledClientToScreen).

Object:ClientToScreen.desc: Convert client coordinates to screen coordinates by walking up the parent chain via ClientToParent/ClientToScreen.

Object:UnscaledClientToScreen.desc: Convert client coordinates to unscaled screen coordinates by walking up the parent chain.

Object:ScreenToLocal.desc: Convert screen coordinates to local coordinates: the parent's ScreenToClient, then subtract the object's own offset.

Object:ScreenToClient.desc: Convert screen coordinates to client coordinates by walking up the parent chain via ParentToClient.

Object:LocalToObject.desc: Convert local coordinates into the coordinate system of obj, walking up until a common ancestor is found; returns -1,-1 when there is no parent.
Object:LocalToObject.returns: x, y in the target object's space; -1, -1 when unreachable

Object:IsVisibleOnScreen.desc: Return whether self and all of its ancestors are visible; a root object without a parent returns false.

Object:_GetMaxChildConstraints.desc: Return the maximum constraint rectangle available to children; the base class returns 0,0,width,height and subclasses override it. (internal)

Object:HitTest.desc: Recursively hit-test children by rectangle and HitTest, returning the first hit object; the subtree is skipped when disableChildrenHitTest is true.
Object:HitTest.returns: the hit child object, or false

Object:IsAbove.desc: Return whether the given point lies above self; equivalent to calling HitTest.

Object:MouseMove.desc: Dispatch OnMouseMove listeners first, then forward the event to the hit child when unhandled.
Object:MouseMove.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:MouseDown.desc: Dispatch OnMouseDown listeners first, then forward the event to the hit child when unhandled.
Object:MouseDown.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:MouseUp.desc: Dispatch OnMouseUp listeners first, then forward the event to the hit child when unhandled.
Object:MouseUp.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:MouseClick.desc: Dispatch OnClick listeners first, then forward the event to the hit child when unhandled.
Object:MouseClick.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:MouseDblClick.desc: Dispatch OnDblClick listeners first, then forward the event to the hit child when unhandled.
Object:MouseDblClick.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:MouseWheel.desc: Dispatch OnMouseWheel listeners first, then forward via weak hit testing (bounding rectangle only) when unhandled.
Object:MouseWheel.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:MouseOver.desc: Dispatch OnMouseOver listeners; not propagated to children.
Object:MouseOver.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:MouseOut.desc: Dispatch OnMouseOut listeners; not propagated to children.
Object:MouseOut.returns: self when a listener handled it

Object:KeyPress.desc: Dispatch OnKeyPress listeners; not propagated to children.
Object:KeyPress.returns: self when a listener handled it, otherwise false

Object:TextInput.desc: Dispatch OnTextInput listeners; not propagated to children.
Object:TextInput.returns: self when a listener handled it, otherwise false

Object:FocusUpdate.desc: Dispatch OnFocusUpdate listeners; not propagated to children.
Object:FocusUpdate.returns: self when a listener handled it, otherwise false

fileDesc: Defines Object, the object base class of Chili UI: parent-child hierarchy, visibility and layering, listener and child event dispatch, coordinate conversion, and the mouse/keyboard event entry points.
